Exactly THREE distinct full-body evolution Forms, one in each equal invisible third, left to right, facing LEFT. Transparent background. Each Form fits inside its own cell with 8% clear margins on all sides, no overlap. Keep approximately equal displayed heights; actual size is metadata. Detailed painterly pixel-art-inspired JRPG creature sprites; deliberate clustered material shading, clear silhouettes at 64px, restrained highlights and clean readable surfaces. Match the approved General roster. Both distinct ordered Types form one cohesive nonhuman identity. The first anchors the creature; the second transforms its materials, anatomy or manifestation. Never substitute an ordinary human. Every Form visibly expresses personhood through a face, prominent eyes, prominent mouth or face-depicting mask. Restrained abstract spirit motifs must serve the concept: floating masks, disembodied eyes, ribbons, separated pieces or object/place/emotion essences. Record intentional surreal anatomy explicitly. Each adjacent Form changes at least two structural axes: silhouette, proportions, posture, body architecture, appendage function or spiritual manifestation. Bigger size and more ornament alone do not qualify. Keep lineage identity, signature motif and materials while following each planned Form. A planned body-plan change is valid. Accidental missing, fused, unattached or duplicate appendages are errors. Full body facing left, one creature per image, transparent alpha, at least 6% clear margins around every tip and effect, no scenery, platforms, text, watermark, grid or ground shadow. Use current approved reference artwork and corrections. Older descriptions and rejected versions must not reintroduce obsolete anatomy. References guide quality and material handling; invent a distinct creature. Anatomy governs physical Techniques and Field Capabilities. No minimum animal mass; dimensions must fit the chosen creature, material and Form. This is a NEW original lineage, not an edit or a copy of an existing creature. Types Aberration / Construct. Domains Void, Magic. Lineage names (do NOT print text): Foldmote → Foldwitness → Archive of Angles.
